title: Description of ICT services
requirement: The contractual arrangements shall include a clear and complete description of all functions and ICT services to be provided by the ICT third-party service provider, indicating whether subcontracting is permitted and, if so, the conditions applying to it.

title: Data processing locations
requirement: The contractual arrangements shall include the locations, namely the regions or countries, where the contracted or subcontracted functions and ICT services are to be provided and where data is to be processed, including the storage location.

title: Data protection provisions
requirement: The contractual arrangements shall include provisions on availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality in relation to the protection of data, including personal data.

title: Business continuity (RTO/RPO)
requirement: The contractual arrangements shall include provisions on ensuring access, recovery and return of data in an easily accessible format, in the case of the insolvency, resolution or discontinuation of business operations of the ICT third-party service provider, or in the case of the termination of the contractual arrangements.

title: Incident reporting
requirement: The contractual arrangements shall include the obligation of the ICT third-party service provider to provide assistance in case of ICT incidents at no additional cost or at a cost that is determined ex ante.

title: Audit and inspection rights
requirement: The contractual arrangements shall include the right of the financial entity, or a third party appointed by the financial entity, to conduct inspections and audits of the ICT third-party service provider, with unrestricted rights of access, inspection and audit.

title: Exit strategy and data portability
requirement: The contractual arrangements shall include clear termination rights and related minimum notice periods for the termination, in accordance with the expectations of competent authorities.

title: Subcontracting chain
requirement: In respect of contractual arrangements concerning the use of ICT services supporting critical or important functions, the ICT third-party service provider shall not subcontract critical or important functions without the prior approval of the financial entity.
